# A rerun narrowed to the changed files prints only the command it runs.
bit
stdout 'gofmt -l a\.go b\.go'
! stdout 'gofmt -l[^\n]*\n(?s:.*)gofmt -l'

cp b.go.changed b.go
bit
stdout 'gofmt -l b\.go'
! stdout 'gofmt -l a\.go'
! stdout 'gofmt -l[^\n]*\n(?s:.*)gofmt -l'

-- BUILD.bit --
check = go.fmt-l {}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/m
-- a.go --
package m
-- b.go --
package m
-- b.go.changed --
package m

const B = 1
